Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the product walkthrough this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the procurement side so your team can finalize the internal path (PO vs card vs marketplace):

- What we covered: Dedicated capacity sizing, requirements for vendor onboarding (W-9/W-8, bank details), and the two common payment flows (PO/invoice vs corporate card via marketplace).
- Items Brightline needs to decide: preferred payment route; if PO/invoice, whether you require NET30 or NET45 and whether a purchase order number will be provided at time of order; if marketplace, which marketplace (AWS Marketplace, Azure/Microsoft, or other) and whether you need an invoice below marketplace thresholds.
- Attachments I requested from you: procurement questionnaire, Brightline PO policy or supplier terms (helps assess contract redlines).

Next steps (proposed):
1) Procurement sends the completed questionnaire + PO policy to procurement@brightline.com and me by EOD Wed (4/7) — we can then prepare the vendor packet and W-9.
2) Redwood will return a completed vendor packet plus our standard W-9 (or W-8 if required) and a one-page payment options summary within 48 hours of receiving your questionnaire.
3) If you prefer a marketplace route, we’ll loop in our partnerships team and confirm listing/contract timing (typically 2–4 weeks).

Ben (cc’d) will attach our vendor packet template in the next message. Evelyn — copying you to keep leadership in the loop on timing and any escalation for custom SLA/PO terms.

Thanks — looking forward to the questionnaire.

Best,

Sara / procurement team —

Appreciate the detail and the PO policy. A few quick answers to your procurement items:

- NET30: Yes, Redwood accepts NET30 on standard SOWs for customers with standard credit profiles. We do not require a separate credit check for Brightline at this stage — we typically provision on a trial credit hold and move to NET30 once the vendor packet is completed.
- W-9 & banking: We can provide a secure DocuSign + secure file upload link. For ACH, we’ll request a voided check or bank letter as part of the vendor packet.
- Marketplace timing: If you choose AWS Marketplace, onboarding (listing + procurement verification) is typically 2–3 weeks after contract execution. If you need faster time-to-value, PO/invoice is usually fastest to production.

I attached our Redwood vendor packet (redwood-vendor-packet.pdf) with the fields we’ll need filled in. If procurement prefers, we can accept the completed form via secure upload or DocuSign.

Next step from our side: once you return the filled questionnaire and indicate preferred payment route, we’ll (1) send our standard W-9 via DocuSign, (2) prepare the final vendor packet, and (3) provision a temporary trial allocation so your infra team can run the pilot while paperwork completes.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call with procurement if that helps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
